content: Aaradhya Verma called insurance agent Anjali Desai to address her expired health policy. Aaradhya missed the expiration date of August 31, 2026, and needed immediate coverage due to a scheduled surgery in October. Anjali presented options including a full-year renewal, an upgrade, and a three-month short-term extension. Aaradhya opted for the three-month extension, and Anjali applied a 5% discount, reducing the cost to $114 per month. Anjali agreed to send a link to sign the extension agreement so coverage would become active immediately.

action_items: Anjali will send a link to sign the short-term extension agreement.
Aaradhya will sign the agreement to activate coverage.
